lines.trans: Forgive me for hiding it from you.
In India I was on an assignment.
The restaurant was only my cover.
I have to watch over you.
I constantly cleaned up after you.
All the best!

examples.text: Ну, допустим, я жулик. А ты жадина и не помогаешь людям в беде.
examples.trans: All right, let's say I'm a crook. But you're greedy, and you don't help people in trouble.

examples.text: Аракелян просит время. Сумма очень большая.
examples.trans: Arakelyan is asking for more time. The sum is very large.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

examples.text: Вы не знаете, что мы на задании?
examples.trans: Don't you know that we're on a mission?

examples.text: Лейтенант, вы не знаете, что мы на задании? К нам нельзя просто так приходить.
examples.trans: Lieutenant, don't you know that we're on a mission? You mustn't just walk in on us.

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!
examples.trans: Because of your Lyolya the whole class calls me a little liar!
We were late because of the rain.

examples.text: А трава в мешках сгорела. Из-за вас!
examples.trans: And the herbs in the sacks burned. Because of you!

examples.text: Они привели нового шеф-повара прямо из Индии.
examples.trans: They brought a new chef straight from India.
I love our town very much.
You're in love with another man's wife!

examples.text: Вниз молнию, вниз! Вот так, очень хорошо.
examples.trans: Zipper down, down! Just like that, very good.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

погибнуть.gloss: to perish, to die (in an accident/war)

meanings.en: to die, to perish, to be killed (in an accident or disaster)

examples.text: Ты же говорила, что он погиб!

examples.trans: His grandfather died in the war.

examples.text: Что?! Это твой отец? Ты же говорила, что он погиб!
examples.trans: What?! That's your father? You said that he died!

meanings.en: to clean up (after someone), tidy away traces

examples.trans: I was constantly cleaning up after you.
He has to clean up other people's mistakes.

meanings.en: to get to, to end up
meanings.note: как попасть в центр? = how do I get to the centre?

examples.trans: A firework hit the power station.
How do I get to the station?

examples.text: Скажи: салют попал в станцию. Три района без света.
examples.trans: Say a firework hit the power station. Three districts without electricity.
What are you constantly afraid of?
He was constantly late for work.
What are you constantly afraid of, Kostik?
Which car did you come in?

examples.text: Вика, ты на какой машине сегодня приехала?
examples.trans: Vika, which car did you come in today?
The restaurant was only my cover.
Was that also your cover story?

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

meanings.note: + infinitive: решил стать = decided to become

examples.text: Суд решил: домашний арест по месту прописки.
examples.trans: The court has decided: house arrest at his registered address.

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.
The wind is blowing hard outside.

examples.text: Я так два года потеряла. Любила так сильно!
examples.trans: I lost two years like that. I loved him so much!

meanings.note: To keep from sight or knowledge.

examples.text: Зачем ты скрывал правду от своей жены?
examples.trans: Why did you hide the truth from your wife?

examples.text: Ты явно скрываешь от меня правду.
examples.trans: You are clearly concealing the truth from me.

examples.text: Я не могу больше скрывать правду.
examples.trans: I can no longer hide the truth.

следить.gloss: to watch, to follow; to keep an eye on

meanings.en: to look after, to keep an eye on

examples.trans: Keep an eye on the child.

examples.text: Марина, я вам обещаю: со стеной ничего не случится.
examples.trans: Marina, I promise you: nothing will happen to the wall.

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
Вот если бы он ребёнка ударил!
examples.trans: Now if he had hit a child!
He hit the table with his fist.

examples.text: Меня всё ребёнок не отпускает. Вот если бы он ребёнка ударил!
examples.trans: I can't stop thinking about a child. Now if he had hit a child!

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
